description: Southco E5-class quarter-turn cam latch as the five parts it is assembled from: latch housing (domed head, double-D body), the compressed sealing washer under the head, the mounting nut, the one-sided formed cam at the full 45 axis-to-tip reach, and the M6 cam screw.
source: Southco E5 literature (head Ø28x5, double-D cutout 20.1/14.1 A/F, depth behind the head 27.2-68.2, cam 45/33 reach, 23 flat, 19 wide, 4 thick, sealing washer 0.5, panel 1, screw M6); mounting-nut A/F and height scaled off the section
